title: Payment Arrangements Collector Guide — Relief-Credit Bonus for Charity Care and Insurance Credits
content:
When a plan under Payment Arrangements is restructured, a relief-credit bonus adds installments to the restructured count according to the client credits booked to the placed account for charity care write-off or insurance payment.

## Rule

The relief-credit bonus follows the client credits booked to the placed account in the last twelve months for charity care write-off or insurance payment:

- credits totalling at least a quarter (0.25) of the account's placed balance add 2 installments;
- smaller such credits add 1;
- no such credit adds none.

The credits are the client adjustment entries with the reason charity care write-off or insurance payment on the money history of the placed account the plan pays, under Placed Consumer Accounts, added together by amount; the placed balance is read from that placed account's record. Periods of twelve months are counted in whole months back from the handling date.

## Grid

| Charity care write-off and insurance payment credits, last 12 months | Compared with the placed balance multiplied by 0.25 | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| One or more, totalling | At least that amount | 2 installments |
| One or more, totalling | Less than that amount | 1 installment |
| None | — | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical account with a placed balance of 4000.00; a quarter is 1000.00)

- An insurance payment credit of 700.00 and a charity care write-off of 300.00 in the last twelve months total 1000.00, at least 1000.00: 2 installments.
- An insurance payment credit of 450.00 alone: smaller than 1000.00 — 1 installment.
- Only a client credit for some other reason: no such credit — none.
